title: Model Conversion Utilities
summary: This module provides utilities and scripts for converting model checkpoints from various original frameworks and formats into Hugging Face Transformers compatible models. It supports a wide range of model architectures and modalities.

nodes.label: Vision Model Converters
nodes.title: Vision Model Converters
nodes.description: Converts general vision models like BEiT, ConvNext, DINOv2, EfficientNet, MobileNet, MobileViT, Swin, and ViT from external formats to Hugging Face Transformers models.

nodes.label: Depth and Segmentation Converters
nodes.title: Depth and Segmentation Converters
nodes.description: Handles the conversion of models specialized in depth estimation and semantic/instance segmentation tasks, such as DPT, GLPN, SegGPT, UperNet, VitMatte, and ZoeDepth.

nodes.label: Video Model Converters
nodes.title: Video Model Converters
nodes.description: Converts models designed for video understanding and processing, specifically VideoMAE, into the Hugging Face Transformers format.

nodes.label: Image Restoration Converters
nodes.title: Image Restoration Converters
nodes.description: Focuses on converting models for image restoration tasks, such as super-resolution, exemplified by Swin2SR.

nodes.label: Pose Estimation Converters
nodes.title: Pose Estimation Converters
nodes.description: Converts models for human pose estimation, including VitPose.

nodes.label: Text Models
nodes.title: Text Model Conversion
nodes.description: Converts various text-based models from their original formats to Hugging Face Transformers.

nodes.label: Multimodal Models
nodes.title: Multimodal Model Conversion
nodes.description: Converts models that handle multiple modalities (e.g., text and vision) to Hugging Face Transformers.

nodes.label: Audio Models
nodes.title: Audio Model Conversion
nodes.description: Converts various audio-based models from their original formats to Hugging Face Transformers.

nodes.label: Gemma Family Models
nodes.title: Gemma Family Model Conversion
nodes.description: Handles the conversion of various Gemma family models to Hugging Face Transformers.

nodes.label: DETR Family Models
nodes.title: DETR Family Model Conversion
nodes.description: Converts object detection models based on the DETR architecture to Hugging Face Transformers.

nodes.label: Other Models
nodes.title: Other Model Conversions
nodes.description: Converts various other model architectures that do not fit into specific categories.

nodes.label: Core Models (Output)
nodes.title: Core Models Repository
nodes.description: The central repository for all converted Hugging Face models.

nodes.label: Model Utilities
nodes.title: Model Utility Functions
nodes.description: Provides helper functions and utilities used across different model conversion processes.

groups.label: Conversion Processes
groups.title: Model Conversion Processes
groups.description: Groups various specialized sub-modules responsible for converting models based on their modality or architecture.

groups.label: Converted Models
groups.title: Converted Model Storage
groups.description: Represents the repository where all models, once converted, are stored and made available for use.

groups.label: Support Tools
groups.title: Supporting Utility Functions
groups.description: Contains helper functions and common utilities leveraged by the conversion processes.
